description: Core Skills composing the SwarmLabs multi-agent scientific experiment automation loop (Planner -> Executor -> Verifier), plus the standalone V&V gate Skill that can refuse that loop's claims.

skills.purpose: Call the SwarmLabs real physics/mathematical model to complete a computation.
depends_on: SwarmLabs v2/run/{engine} API or MCP server
skills.safety: Read-only computation; does not mutate external state; does not log sensitive parameters.

skills.purpose: Generate an experiment design from a user goal.
Active-learning sampling: pick the next most informative experiment point.

skills.safety: Does not emit secrets or internal implementation details.

skills.purpose: Independent third-party adjudication of a numeric claim against held-out ground truth and literature anchors. Answers 'your prediction is wrong' — not merely 'your run is reproducible' — and returns a blocking exit code.

input.check: key? -> static gate decision from the published ledger
input.template: key -o out.json -> held-out points as an editable prediction file
input.verify: key --pred p.json -> POST /v3/verify, dynamic adjudication of YOUR prediction

output.coverage: number? (only when y_std supplied; null means not evaluated, not 1)

skills.dependencies: none (Python 3.8+ stdlib only; no numpy, no API key, no engine clone)
skills.safety: Read-only over published endpoints. Sends your predictions outbound only. Fail-closed: ERROR maps to BLOCK, absent policy returns 503 rather than a silent default.
consumer_notes: Cloudflare returns 403 error code 1010 for an empty User-Agent or the stdlib default Python-urllib/x.y; an explicit UA is required.
x must match the published held-out x within 1e-6 or the submission is rejected with 400 + the offending index.
Prediction count must equal the published count (400 bad_request with n_expected/n_got otherwise).
Thresholds live in exactly one place: engine/verification_gate.py::thresholds(), exported at build time into gate_policy.
